explanation_full:
The overall performance comparison indicates that the KNN model performed best, achieving an R2 score of 0.8172. When examining feature importance, VSS was identified as the most critical feature (importance=0.5052), followed by Acetate (0.12) and Butyrate (0.097). The feature selection process revealed that the optimal subset of features for the KNN model consists of 9 features, yielding an R2 score of 0.8301. These key features are VFA, Butyrate, Acetate, VSS, Propionate, Ethanol, COD-O, pH, and ORP_Low. This suggests that the combination of these variables provides the strongest predictive power for the model.
